# anthropic_compliance_groups (Data Source)

Lists RBAC and SCIM-provisioned groups across the parent tree, including the role ids attached to each group (which the Admin API `anthropic_rbac_groups` data source does not expose). Requires `compliance_api_key` (a Compliance Access Key) or an `enterprise_api_key` carrying the `read:compliance_org_data` scope; Admin API keys are rejected.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_compliance_groups" "all" {}

output "scim_groups" {
  value = [for g in data.anthropic_compliance_groups.all.groups : g.name if g.source_type == "scim"]
}
```

## Schema

### Read-Only

- `groups` (Attributes List) Groups. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups))

<a id="nestedatt--groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `groups`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) Group description; may be null.
- `id` (String) Group id (`rbac_group_...`).
- `name` (String) Group name.
- `roles` (List of String) Role ids assigned to the group.
- `source_type` (String) `direct` (created in claude.ai) or `scim`.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
